change.summary: Standalone development gallery reuses current JEM GUI source and native pixels, while the sandbox-only Cinematic adapter preserves JEI and inventory interaction ownership inside block scenes.

modifiers.after: Unchanged. Gallery and Cinematic adapter are excluded from ManagedPack, Server, test jem, shared production inventories and release baseline.

modifiers.before: JEI could not discover a container menu behind Cinematic Interactions SceneScreen
modifiers.after: Only while JEI was opened from SceneScreen, its native transfer lookup receives the player's active block menu and retains JEI's own transfer-handler eligibility rules.

modifiers.before: Global AbstractContainerScreen interception replaced normal Shift + left-click behavior but could not operate SceneScreen
modifiers.after: Only SceneScreen consumes Shift + left-button drag and delegates every crossed player or station slot to Cinematic Interactions' native quick-transfer path. Ordinary containers and Creative inventory remain untouched.

cause.kind: development-only GUI packaging and isolated local presentation adapters

rationale.purpose: Browse and click the existing JEM screens in jem sandbox without gameplay outcomes; add exact native GUI mods and mandatory dependencies to that profile.
rationale.decision_source: User requested clickable GUIs without logic and explicitly selected reproducing existing screens. Relocation, local snapshots, explicit source admission and native-renderer delegation are implementation choices.

introduced.summary: Add sandbox-only gallery and native GUI mod install boundary.

history.summary: Current domain presentation sources remain canonical; JEM actions have no production authority. Native third-party GUI mods retain their ordinary behavior.
Expose the active SceneScreen block menu to native JEI transfer discovery and confine Shift + left-drag quick movement to Cinematic block scenes.

relations: canonical domain screen -> relocated presentation artifact -> local demo transport
SceneScreen -> active vanilla menu -> native JEI recipe transfer handler
SceneScreen hovered slot -> Cinematic native quick-transfer path
exact installed native mod metadata -> sandbox-only dependency closure
notes: No original registry facts, canonical balance, saved data or production dependencies are changed.
Native mods are installed unmodified; their native gameplay is distinct from the inert JEM gallery.
Ordinary container and Creative inventory input remains owned by Minecraft and Mouse Tweaks.
The existing sandbox race renderer is an explicit required presentation dependency.
unresolved: Runtime JEI transfer-button visibility, bidirectional sweep coverage and player acceptance remain unobserved; no game or automated tests were launched.
